name: Argentiferous-Astrolabe
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past dust seas stretching to the horizon, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Whoever abandoned the buried megastructure did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
